sloka: उद्यत आयुध हस्तानाम् राक्षस इन्द्र अनुयायिनाम् ।सम्भ्रमो रक्षसाम् एष तुमुलो लोम हर्षणः ।। ६-३३-२९।।
transliteration: udyata āyudha hastānām rākṣasa indra anuyāyinām ।sambhramo rakṣasām eṣa tumulo loma harṣaṇaḥ ।। 6-33-29।।

translations.english: "Listen to the bustle of noise of the Rakshasas lifting the weapons, ringing of the bells (of elephants), and rattling of chariots, and neighing of horses. Listen to the flourish of the trumpets. The happy Rakshasas are making tumultuous noise causing horripilation."
